title: Pocketwire Savings Vault APY Rate Sheet
content:
Pocketwire Savings Vault interest is quoted as an annual percentage yield (APY) for each tier. Bonus rates are quoted in percentage points of APY.

## Rates by tier

| | Pocketwire Vault Essential | Pocketwire Vault Select | Pocketwire Vault Preferred | Pocketwire Vault Premier | Pocketwire Vault Reserve | Pocketwire Vault Private |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Base APY | 0.50% | 1.25% | 2.50% | 3.25% | 3.75% | 4.10% |
| Balance cap for the base APY | $5000.00 | $10000.00 | $25000.00 | $50000.00 | $100000.00 | $250000.00 |
| Overflow APY | 0.10% | 0.25% | 0.50% | 1.00% | 1.50% | 2.00% |
| Promotional bonus on the first vault | 0.00 points | 0.25 points | 0.50 points | 0.50 points | 0.75 points | 1.00 points |
| Promotional period | 0 months | 3 months | 3 months | 3 months | 6 months | 6 months |
| Direct deposit bonus | 0.00 points | 0.10 points | 0.10 points | 0.25 points | 0.25 points | 0.25 points |
| Direct deposit threshold for the bonus | $1000.00 | $1000.00 | $1000.00 | $1000.00 | $1000.00 | $1000.00 |
| Time-lock bonus | 0.00 points | 0.00 points | 0.25 points | 0.35 points | 0.50 points | 0.60 points |

## Notes to the rate sheet

1. **Base APY** is the annual percentage yield on the part of the customer's combined vault balance up to the balance cap of the tier.
2. **Overflow APY** is the annual percentage yield on the part of the combined vault balance above that balance cap.
3. **Promotional bonus** is extra APY on the customer's first vault for its first months, the promotional period being counted in calendar months from the opening date of that first vault. A tier showing 0.00 points over 0 months carries no promotional bonus.
4. **Direct deposit bonus** is extra APY while the linked Pocketwire Personal Account received direct deposits of at least the direct deposit threshold in the previous calendar month.
5. **Time-lock bonus** is extra APY on a vault while it is time-locked. The sheet shows 0.00 points for Pocketwire Vault Essential and Pocketwire Vault Select.

## Reading the sheet (hypothetical customers)

- A hypothetical Pocketwire Vault Select customer with a combined vault balance of $12000.00: the first $10000.00 is quoted at the base APY of 1.25% and the remaining $2000.00 at the overflow APY of 0.25%.
- A hypothetical Pocketwire Vault Private customer with a combined vault balance of $180000.00: the whole balance lies within the $250000.00 cap and is quoted at the base APY of 4.10%.
- A hypothetical Pocketwire Vault Premier customer whose linked personal account received $1000.00 of direct deposits last calendar month meets the threshold exactly; one who received $999.99 does not.
